**Only the dots that move take the red accent.** Turning **Red accents** on was recolouring the whole dot field,
including the resting grid that sits still behind the Home screen. The accent now colours the marks that carry
motion — the sweep band and the effect dots — while the resting grid stays grey, so the red reads as a highlight
instead of a background.

**The panel rows no longer hold a lit pill after a toggle.** Flipping a switch left its row with a filled
background until you left the panel and came back: Steam keeps the row focused after the switch, so a fill keyed to
the row stayed lit. The row is now marked by the left-edge bar alone, which cannot stick, so the fill follows the
control under the cursor and nothing is left behind.

**Everything else stayed as it was.** Nothing outside the Home dot field and the row focus marker changed in this
release, and the plugin still only changes how Steam looks, never how it works.

**Install / update:** grab `VoidDeck-v1.8.2.zip` from the [v1.8.2 release](https://github.com/endoflineservice/VoidDeck/releases/tag/v1.8.2), or press **Update now** in the Void Deck panel.
